questions.title: Score Band Lookup
questions.prompt: Given an integer start, a list of integer changes, and non-overlapping intervals [low, high, label], return the label whose interval contains start + sum(changes). Intervals use low <= value < high. Return 'out' if none match.
questions.hint: Compute the final score once, then scan the intervals.

questions.title: Vowel Case Flip
questions.prompt: Given a string, change every vowel to the opposite case while leaving every other character unchanged.
questions.hint: Check whether ch.lower() is in the set of vowels.

questions.title: Index Chain Walk
questions.prompt: A list next_index stores the next position for each index. Start at start and follow the chain until -1 or until the next step would revisit an index. Return the visited indices in order.
questions.hint: Use a set to remember visited indices.
questions.solution:
def chain_walk(next_index, start):
    seen = set()
    order = []
    cur = start
    while cur != -1 and cur not in seen:
        seen.add(cur)
        order.append(cur)
        cur = next_index[cur]
    return order

questions.title: Run Compression
questions.prompt: Compress each maximal run of equal characters as character + count. Return the original string when the compressed result is not shorter.
questions.hint: Build output pieces in a list and join once.

questions.title: Minimum Increments for Non-Decreasing
questions.prompt: You may increase any element by 1 in one operation. Return the minimum number of operations needed to make nums non-decreasing.
questions.hint: Scan left to right and raise values that fall below the previous fixed value.
